name: HyperDX adoption and usage — Production
description: Usage reporting from authenticated HyperDX API logs. Counts query requests, including automatic refreshes; search/filter text is recovered from the originating page URL. Registered-user totals are omitted until a live data source is available. Production namespace: hyperdx-platform-prd. Uses authenticated API logs from prod_logs.fluentLogsPlatformCluster, which contains the platform cluster hosting HyperDX. The all-clusters view excludes this cluster. Empty input returns no metric rather than a zero-adoption claim. Counts cover ClickHouse requests; PromQL requests are not counted.

config.name: Users with activity
config.sqlTemplate:
WITH
  substring(log, position(log, '{')) AS event,
  lowerUTF8(JSONExtractString(event, 'userEmail')) AS user_email,
  JSONExtractString(event, 'req', 'headers', 'referer') AS page_url,
  JSONExtractString(event, 'req', 'url') AS request_url,
  JSONExtractString(event, 'req', 'headers', 'x-request-id') AS request_id,
  if(request_id != '', request_id, concat(JSONExtractString(event, 'hostname'), ':', toString(JSONExtractUInt(event, 'time')), ':', toString(JSONExtractUInt(event, 'req', 'id')))) AS event_id,
  startsWith(request_url, '/clickhouse-proxy') AS is_query,
  decodeURLComponent(decodeURLComponent(extractURLParameter(page_url, 'where'))) AS search_text,
  decodeURLComponent(decodeURLComponent(extractURLParameter(page_url, 'source'))) AS source_id,
  decodeURLComponent(extractURLParameter(page_url, 'whereLanguage')) AS query_language,
  decodeURLComponent(decodeURLComponent(extractURLParameter(page_url, 'filters'))) AS structured_filters
SELECT uniqExact(user_email) AS Users
FROM prod_logs.fluentLogsPlatformCluster
WHERE timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})
  AND timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
  AND namespace_name = 'hyperdx-platform-prd'
  AND container_name = 'app'
  AND startsWith(log, '[API] ')
  AND user_email != ''
  AND startsWith(JSONExtractString(event, 'msg'), 'HTTP ')
HAVING count() > 0

SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} SECOND) AS ts, uniqExact(user_email) AS Users

WITH

  JSONExtractString(event, 'req', 'headers', 'referer') AS page_url,

FROM prod_logs.fluentLogsPlatformCluster
WHERE timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})

FROM prod_logs.fluentLogsPlatformCluster

config.name: Data freshness
config.sqlTemplate:
WITH
  substring(log, position(log, '{')) AS event,
  lowerUTF8(JSONExtractString(event, 'userEmail')) AS user_email,
  JSONExtractString(event, 'req', 'headers', 'referer') AS page_url,
  JSONExtractString(event, 'req', 'url') AS request_url,
  JSONExtractString(event, 'req', 'headers', 'x-request-id') AS request_id,
  if(request_id != '', request_id, concat(JSONExtractString(event, 'hostname'), ':', toString(JSONExtractUInt(event, 'time')), ':', toString(JSONExtractUInt(event, 'req', 'id')))) AS event_id,
  startsWith(request_url, '/clickhouse-proxy') AS is_query,
  decodeURLComponent(decodeURLComponent(extractURLParameter(page_url, 'where'))) AS search_text,
  decodeURLComponent(decodeURLComponent(extractURLParameter(page_url, 'source'))) AS source_id,
  decodeURLComponent(extractURLParameter(page_url, 'whereLanguage')) AS query_language,
  decodeURLComponent(decodeURLComponent(extractURLParameter(page_url, 'filters'))) AS structured_filters
SELECT min(timestamp) AS First_event_in_period, max(timestamp) AS Latest_event, dateDiff('second', max(timestamp), now()) AS Latest_event_age_seconds, uniqExactIf(event_id,is_query AND search_text != '') AS Requests_with_search_text, uniqExactIf(event_id,is_query AND search_text = '') AS Requests_without_search_text
FROM prod_logs.fluentLogsPlatformCluster
WHERE timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})
  AND timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
  AND namespace_name = 'hyperdx-platform-prd'
  AND container_name = 'app'
  AND startsWith(log, '[API] ')
  AND user_email != ''
  AND startsWith(JSONExtractString(event, 'msg'), 'HTTP ')
HAVING count() > 0

config.name: Metric definitions
config.markdown:
**Users with activity:** distinct users in authenticated API request logs. **Query requests:** ClickHouse proxy requests, including live tail, background queries, and retries—not deliberate Run clicks. **Search patterns:** distinct source, language, text, and filter combinations visible in page URLs; generated SQL is not recorded. Recent searches consolidate repeated requests. Trends use the selected time buckets; unique users across buckets must not be summed. Registered-user totals and adoption percentages are omitted until a live registration source is available. Check Data freshness for actual coverage.

**Production coverage:** Uses authenticated API logs from `hyperdx-platform-prd` in `prod_logs.fluentLogsPlatformCluster`. The all-clusters view excludes this cluster. Check Data freshness for coverage in the selected period. PromQL requests are not counted.
